portfolio_selection: First five within top15 with approximate prior20day median turnover at least TRY5000000
exit_rule: Static base target: first subsequent high reaching target; fill at max(target, open); otherwise deadline close. No supported positive earnings target => hold to deadline.
project_premium: No premium without dated complete incremental economics; revenue/backlog is not profit.
missing_data: None with explicit reason, never automatic zero
fair_value_status: Uncalibrated forward earnings scenarios, not verified fair values
bank_holding_reit: Separate sector models required; unsupported sectors not forced into industrial formula
